name: codebase-mirror
description: Structural code awareness across all scanned projects. Indexes registries, routes, services, schemas, and detects drift automatically. Agents get code context injected without reading entire files.
shortDescription: Codebase indexing and drift detection for AI agents
author: QUOX
marketingPoints: Auto-detect project types (React, Go, TypeScript, Rust, Python)
Registry sync validation — catch mismatches before they break things
30-token context injection — agents know your architecture without reading files
Drift detection — see exactly what changed between scans
Remote scanning via QuoxAgent — index code on any fleet machine

scan.name: Project Scanning
scan.description: Detect project type, extract registries, routes, services, schemas

drift.name: Drift Detection
drift.description: Compare scans over time, detect added/removed/modified elements

query.name: Query API
query.description: Agents query specific elements on demand via /api/v1/codebase/:id/query

implant.name: Cognitive Implant
implant.description: Codebase Fabric implant in Cognitive Topology with live metrics

visualization.name: Visual Explorer
visualization.description: Browse project structure, registries, routes, and invariants in the dashboard

changes: Initial release: scanner engine, storage, diff engine
API endpoints: scan, query, diff, summary, markdown
Dashboard view: project cards, registry explorer, invariant panel
